_about: The 0.47 art pass (PixelLab, from 2026-10-06): Book II's stand-in recolours replaced in place, plus the story's missing portraits and the postgame's hall and tide art. Foes: create_image_pixflux 200x200 with the template below (1 gen), animate_image attack + hurt 5 frames (3 gens each), walk 8 frames from a 64px copy (1 gen); install with the scratchpad's install_monster.py (one shared crop box). Keys and names stay, so no code changes for foes.
foe_template: dark fantasy pixel art monster, full body, standing, three-quarter view facing left: {look}, {palette}

portraits._note: Champions: create_image_pro_flash 96x200 with the Brannoch portrait as style reference; walk + skill 8 frames each from a 64px copy (animate_image). Heroes: 82x200 like assets/heroes. Needs code: a unique portrait for Morrow and the First Signatory as heroes (today they use the class portrait).

hollowborn._note: Hollow-born recruits today wear a sea-glass hue shift of their class portrait. Real art: one 82x200 portrait per class in the heroes' style (needs a small code change: a Hollow-born hero uses assets/heroes/hollow_<class>.png when it exists; battle sprites keep the tint).
